_meta.note: Scaffold -- 12 evergreen POD styles. Edit freely. Three rules matter: (1) text_strategy is 'model_rendered' -- the model draws the lettering itself, so each style carries a 'lettering' fragment describing how that text should look. (2) No Midjourney '--no' syntax anywhere; Flux/SDXL endpoints ignore it or read it as positive prompt text, meaning a '--no mockup' suffix plausibly ASKS for a mockup. (3) palette_hint, graphic and lettering are SCANNED for colour words to pick the chroma ground the print stage keys out -- see prompts.ground_for_style. Adding 'magenta' to a palette moves that style off the magenta ground automatically; a style that names magenta, green, cyan AND yellow leaves nothing safe to key, and printready will report the collision.
_meta.ground_note: You do not set the background colour here. prompts.output_suffix appends it, chosen per style to avoid that style's own palette, and printready.remove_ground keys it out on the way to the 4500x5400 transparent PNG. Do not write background instructions into 'graphic' -- two ground instructions in one prompt is how you get a full-bleed rectangle no removal can save. MEASURED 2026-08-17: the models do not comply. 3 of 3 real generations on the Hugging Face routes painted their own ground instead of the requested one (#FF00FF -> #D53536, #00FF00 -> #000000, #FF00FF -> #F40034), and the black one then collided with its own outlines at 4.5% of the art. All three files were still usable because printready keys the border colour it actually finds, not the one asked for. Treat ground_hint as a diagnostic rather than a contract: it exists so an ignored ground is visible instead of silent, and review.py reports that warning without blocking an approval on it. The rule above still holds -- do not write background instructions into 'graphic' -- because two ground instructions make the detected border unpredictable, which is the one thing removal actually depends on.
_meta.text_rendering_caveat: Image models draw letterforms, they do not typeset. Spelling is not guaranteed and there is no verification stage configured. Misspelled or malformed lettering will reach the manual review queue. The 'lettering' fragment biases toward short, simple text because short text fails less often.

text_layout_fields.font_role: display | script | slab | sans | serif -- describes the LOOK requested of the model, not a font file
